purpose: Classify the non-consumable terminal JobLevel marker in the frozen canonical hero job-material consumer without treating Count, name, ID, or UI position as an independent semantic heuristic.

classification.terminalRelation: final level in the source-order-preserved connection.levels array
requiredInvariant: Every canonical hero JobConnection has exactly one matching material entry.
The matching entry belongs to the terminal source-order-preserved JobLevel.
The terminal JobLevel contains only that matching marker entry.
No other Count 999 material entry exists in the canonical hero JobConnection population.
JobMaterial ID 40 with any other count remains a normal material and is not excluded.
classification.presentationEligibility: Exclude only the validated terminal marker entry; all other material entries remain eligible.

completionRule: The independent validator must prove the invariant over the current frozen hero-job-material artifact with zero errors before frontend presentation may exclude the marker.
